title: Lovable's Creative Engine Update: Multi-Model Routing, Design Previews — and What It Means for Builders
summary: Lovable shipped multi-model routing, design previews, and a Skills feature. Here's what actually changed, what it still doesn't cover (database, auth, hosting), and how Blink compares.
body_markdown: Lovable's design previews generate three directions before you commit — useful when you're not sure which visual path to take.[Blink](https://blink.new/blog/%5BREDACTED%5D) uses iterative refinement: build, see the actual output, shape it in context. Neither is strictly better — the right approach depends on whether you prefer to decide upfront or react to real output. If you've ever spent time choosing between abstract mockups only to find none of them quite worked once built, iterative refinement may save more time overall.
